title: Baltimore Civil War Museum

services.name: Program Guidelines
services.desc: This program is an added benefit for individual members of participating Greater Baltimore History Alliance (GBHA) sites. Museum members who join one participating site at a level equivalent to $100 or above can enjoy free general admission when visiting other participating GBHA
